reviews.text: I have been coming here for over 10 years and the veterinarians  here are the best. They have saved many of our dogs, lives and extended them for years to come. However, ever since this was taken over by a corporation, I feel it it’s becoming less personal and more about money. The examination fees and the re-examination fees have gone up by at least $20. There is certain drugs that my dog needs that I was paying $15 less three months ago and I’ve been raised. It seems all they care about is money right now and not your Pets health and I say this with sadness because I know there’s lots of vets there that really care about your pets, but this corporation is making it almost impossible for the average American to afford health care for their pet without going into severe credit card debt. I think they need to reassess their business plan. Unfortunately, my family and I are considering getting another Vet.

The young girl at the front desk is nasty. Don’t go into healthcare if you don’t like helping people. And barely makes eye contact when she talks to you. I watched a man with a hearing aid struggle to converse with her through the glass. And then another older couple. Not nice. 3 workers at the front desk and 0 attentiveness to customer service and helping people.

Love Dr Shull!! He is very patient and takes his time to explain everything and answer any questions i have....AND..I must say, Ellen at the front desk is the BEST! She is very professional and a great pleasure to talk with...i miss her very much on her days off when Jack and I are visiting!!

I can’t say enough good things about Richmond Valley Vet. We brought Dino in with a urinary blockage, and I was scared out of my mind. Dr. Shull, Adrea, and the whole staff were so kind to both of us. They explained what was happening, kept me informed through his surgery, and made me feel confident that Dino was in good hands.

What meant the most was how well they treated him. Dino isn’t just a dog to us—he’s family—and I could tell they cared about him. I’m so grateful to Dr. Shull, Adrea, and everyone who helped him through such a scary day. Thank you for taking such good care of my boy.

Also a very very special Thank you to Adrea. You are an absolute queen!!

We have been coming to Richmond Valley since the 90s and they are still the best of the best. Staff is kind and the Vets provide excellent care. From vaccines to mastectomy’s I wouldn’t trust anywhere else with our babies.

Thank you for your positive rating. We appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you again.
Dr. Powell is caring, professional and friendly . Our dog Addy loves him. I highly recommend Dr. Powell and Richmond Valley Vet.

I can’t say enough positive things about the Richmond Valley Veterinary team! The front desk staff is always kind, professional, and accommodating. During many recent emergencies, they have gone above and beyond to get my dog seen as quickly as possible, and that level of care and compassion means more than I can say.

The veterinary technicians are truly the MVPs, especially Ricky, whose patience, gentleness, and compassion always stand out. It is so reassuring to know my dog is being handled with such genuine care, especially when he isn’t feeling his best.

And our regular veterinarian, Dr. Shull, is truly the best. He has been caring for my dog for 16 years and counting, and I couldn’t ask for a more dedicated, knowledgeable, and compassionate doctor. He is not only an exceptional veterinarian but a genuinely wonderful person. Despite how busy he is, he always takes the time to listen, answer my endless questions, explain everything clearly, and make sure both my dog and I feel heard and cared for. That kind of trust is invaluable.

I feel incredibly lucky to have a veterinary team I can rely on and trust so completely. I am so grateful for every single person who has cared for him over the years. Thank you!

Dr. Esposito an amazing sympathetic person overall. I went to 3 different ER vet for my dog in NJ, & PA. Both
giving me the option of surgery or euthanasia. I was disgusted and heartbroken, all for a lifestyle change? I was recommended Dr.Esposito and I was extremely happy with the visit. She listened, and she spoke. The other vets did not, nor did they feel an oz of sadness for what was going on. We were at richmond valley for about 3 hours discussing my dogs needs, what meds to be put on, fluids, etc. My dog was given hope and love by the same Doctor and I couldn’t be happier with everything. I am grateful for Dr.Esposito and highly recommend her.

Dr.Osterman is the absolute best! She is extremely sweet and caring. She answers every question and concern we have, always making us feel heard and valued. I really appreciate all she does for our pup and can’t imagine being treated elsewhere. Thank you Dr.Osterman for everything!

As with any service industry, some people are not wired to deal w/the public & others are well suited. Our dogs have been long time patients of RV, some vets are very good others not so much.
We alternate between two vets based on their availability & our schedules . TBH, we miss our long term vet that retired. Some of the office staff/vet techs are super stars others need to be coached on how to be appropriately   interacting w/owners. Yet, zero complaints/issues with the care/treatment of our multiple fur babies . One Vet  even gave us their personal cell # if we ever had medical issues. We had to contact said Vet several times & the response times were immediate. Overall zero complaints . Lisa the groomer is a superstar, our babies, multiple size dogs look like they are show dogs when they leave her! Sadly the grooming area looks like a dungeon or prison, it's actually scary to enter, even the doors need to be replaced. With the amount of $ this practice makes, the grooming area should look like a spa!
